entities.name: Edward C. Eicher
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Edward Clayton Eicher was a United States representative from Iowa, federal securities regulator and Chief Justice of the District Court of the United States for the District of Columbia. He was considered a consummate New Deal liberal.
